description: This Java class 'ImmutableJsonFieldSelectorFactory' parses complex JSON field selector strings to create ImmutableJsonFieldSelector instances, handling URL decoding, parentheses, and comma-separated paths.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonFieldSelectorFactory
classes.description: Factory class for parsing JSON field selector strings into ImmutableJsonFieldSelector objects, supporting nested and URL-encoded syntax.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new factory instance from a JSON field selector string with parsing options, decoding URL if specified.

methods.name: tryToDecodeString
methods.description: Attempts to URL-decode the input string, throws exception if decoding fails.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Performs URL decoding on the string if enabled in options.

methods.name: splitAroundComma
methods.description: Splits a string at top-level commas, respecting parentheses to avoid splitting inside nested expressions.

methods.name: flattenToJsonPointers
methods.description: Converts list of raw JSON key strings into a set of JsonPointer objects, handling nested selector syntax.

methods.name: isJsonSelectorFormat
methods.description: Checks if a string is in JSON selector format based on parentheses.

methods.name: flattenToJsonPointers (overload)
methods.description: Recursively processes a string with parentheses to produce a set of JsonPointer objects with proper path concatenation.

methods.name: validateJsonFieldSelectorString
methods.description: Validates the selector string for emptiness and balanced parentheses.

methods.name: getCountOf
methods.description: Counts occurrences of a specific parenthesis character in the selector string.

methods.name: newJsonFieldSelector
methods.description: Builds an ImmutableJsonFieldSelector from the parsed JSON pointers.
